Klipnux identifies natural speaking turns, reframes your video for vertical feeds or widescreen players, and burns clean, editable captions right into the MP4.

How Klipnux works.

Three simple steps from a long interview or lecture to clean short-form files.

STEP 01

Drop any length video

Upload MP4, MOV, MKV, or WEBM recordings straight from your device with zero server upload wait or length caps.

STEP 02

Discover & adjust clips

Find high-energy scenes, slice custom moments on the timeline, reframe speakers, and pick your viral caption preset.

STEP 03

Add captions & export

Preview live synchronized subtitles in real time, tweak every spoken word or script, and download crisp 1080p clips or ZIP.

Studio Pro Workflow Tips

Practical shortcuts for faster editing
Zero-wait local studio

Drop any large MP4/MOV file directly into Upload Video to scan peaks, scrub the timeline, add captions, and render offline in your browser.

Write or dictate captions

Inside the Adjust panel, tap Add Script to paste speech text or use Voice Dictate, then hit Sync Captions for timed karaoke words.

Keyboard & speaker framing

Use Space to play/pause, I / O to mark start and end cuts, and Focus Left / Right to reframe two-person podcasts cleanly.
